title: AnnotationEvent
description: An AR annotation operation authored by the technician (agent) on a 2D video frame and rendered as a world-anchored marker on the phone. The phone raycasts the normalized point into its ARCore/ARKit scene and attaches a persistent anchor.

op.description: create: place a new annotation. update: move/restyle. delete: remove one. clear: remove all.

id.description: Client-generated unique id (UUID) correlating the agent's annotation with the phone's anchor.

point.description: Normalized tap point on the agent's video frame. The phone raycasts this into the AR scene. Required for create.

path.description: Ordered normalized points for a freehand stroke.

frameId.description: Video frame the point refers to, for timestamp matching. v1 raycasts against the latest frame and tolerates small drift.

anchorId.description: Set by the phone in echoed events: the platform AR anchor id backing this annotation.
